brief:
Voters headed to polling stations across Israel to elect 120 members of the Knesset in an election that will determine whether Benjamin Netanyahu's rightwing coalition can remain in power, The Guardian reported. The vote carries major implications for Israeli politics and the regional landscape.

The election centers on Netanyahu's ability to maintain his current governing coalition amid ongoing political divisions and disputes within the government.
dek: Voters head to the polls to elect 120 members of the Knesset in an election that will determine whether Benjamin Netanyahu’s rightwing coalition can remain in power.
title: Israelis vote on Netanyahu coalition's future
